meta.name: self-review-extension
meta.description: This skill should be loaded by `reviewer:self-review` when configuring a review run in this repository. Extend self-review with plugin structure and Codex review types with per-type scopes, lower confidence threshold to 70, and add marketplace registry pre-flight checks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定制代码审查的规则与检查项
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望按项目自定义代码审查流程和范围。
copy.tagline_en: Customize code review rules and scopes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to tailor code review workflows per project.

howto.what: 配置自审时,Claude 会调整默认自审配置:增加新审查类型(普通技能与插件技能,对应技能未安装则跳过),把置信度门槛降到 70,并先核对插件注册表与磁盘目录,标出未注册或失效的插件项。
howto.when: 在本仓库配置审查运行(review run)时,由 `reviewer:self-review` 加载生效;也就是每次设定自审流程时触发。

say.text: 给本仓库配置自审,并加载 self-review-extension。
say.note: Claude 应用扩展的审查类型、置信度与预检步骤。

say.text: 为自审增加 review-plugin 和 review-codex 类型。
say.note: Claude 会加入这些类型;对应技能未装则跳过。

say.text: 先核对 marketplace.json 的插件注册与磁盘目录。
say.note: Claude 先执行插件预检再启动审查任务。

howto.what_en: Loaded for self-review, Claude extends the default config: adds local and plugin review types, lowers confidence threshold to 70, and pre-checks marketplace registries against plugin directories, flagging unregistered or orphaned entries.
howto.when_en: Triggered by `reviewer:self-review` when configuring a review run in this repository, i.e., whenever a self-review configuration session starts.

say_en.text: Configure a self-review for this repo and load self-review-extension.
say_en.note: Claude applies this extension's config for the review.

say_en.text: Add the review-plugin and review-codex types for this self-review.
say_en.note: Claude adds them; the Codex one is skipped if missing.

say_en.text: Pre-check the marketplace registries against the plugin directories.
say_en.note: Claude reports unregistered or orphaned plugins.
